title: A personal AI timeline that remembers what matters
caption: Post fragments of your day as text, photos, URLs or speech. Dedicated personas connect them with what you shared before.

title: Bring back a forgotten plan at the right moment
caption: A missed restaurant visit becomes useful again when you mention another trip. Personas can surface relevant memories during check-ins.

title: Create personas for the people and interests in your life
caption: Describe a persona in plain language. Each person or interest can have its own memory, instructions and tools.

title: Inspect, trace and correct what your AI remembers
caption: Open a persona’s memory, follow facts back to their original posts, edit them or forget them. Original timeline posts stay intact.

title: Understand who responds and refine the behavior
caption: Inspect which personas received a post and why others did not. Adjust routing conditions or preview a revised reply before applying it.

title: Find saved fragments by words or meaning
caption: Search your timeline by keyword, meaning, date or persona, and keep useful posts and replies in favorites.

title: Connect external agents to your personal timeline
caption: Hermes or Obsidian’s LLM Connect Hub can research and answer through MCP. kakeratta keeps the timeline, schedules and memory updates.

title: NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory
caption: Super routes each post and handles everyday answers and notes; Super VL plans schedules and runs the daily check-ins. Ultra composes deep answers. A tagged record is added after publication; records are folded into grounded facts at check-in.

title: A month of fragments, connected
caption: Monthly summaries bring people, food and unfinished plans together with links back to the original posts.

title: Keep useful posts and answers in favorites
caption: Favorite both your own posts and persona replies, then return to them from the saved-entry view.

title: Capture a thought even while offline
caption: Write while disconnected. Posts stay in this browser’s outbox until the connection returns and delivery can resume.

title: Preview exactly what you share to Bluesky
caption: Choose text or image for each selected message, inspect the result inline, and press Post to publish the conversation to Bluesky.

title: See what each persona costs and what drives it
caption: Inspect each persona’s monthly AI costs and web search counts, split into replies, scheduled runs and other work. Compare them with the overall total, including shared processing.

title: Turn notes and conversations into infographics
caption: Ask the infographic persona to turn existing notes, articles or conversations into visual cards with emoji and Mermaid diagrams. Powered by Nemotron Ultra.

title: Keep the small details about your people
caption: A person’s timeline connects shared meals, preferences and upcoming occasions, helping small details stay useful.
